headline: Dalet Labs emerges from stealth with a $7M pre-seed and launches AI shopping app Scene
summary: Lightspeed-led pre-seed; Scene is an iPhone app with a personalized feed of AI-generated images linking to real products.

headline: Prism Data launches REFRACT, an AI transaction-categorization engine
summary: Trained on 30B+ bank transactions; underpins Prism's next-generation CashScore cash-flow underwriting models. Announced alongside its $20M Series A.

headline: Coast raised $40M Series B
summary: Coast is a Visa fleet fuel and gas card plus expense management solution that helps fleets control and track employee spending on fuel and other expenses.

headline: Amazon acquires Fauna Robotics, maker of the Sprout humanoid robot
summary: Fauna Robotics now operates as an Amazon company; its team joins Amazon in New York.

headline: Postman acquires Fern
summary: Postman acquired Fern, the API docs and SDK-generation company; Fern continues as a product and brand.
